result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. The module compiles, but I haven't run any tests.

In `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, the remainder branch now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. So an unmatched contributor with a latest commit older than 180 days is left out. Contributors matched to a configured team still go through the earlier branch, so those teams keep all their members. `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date, so contributors with a missing latest-commit date count as active.

I didn't check whether `DateUtils.getCalendar()` uses the analysis date or the current date, so the 180-day cutoff may be measured from the wrong one.
